headline: Full-Stack Developer | Web Applications | API Design
summary: Full-Stack Developer with hands-on experience building and maintaining web applications end to end. Comfortable across the front end and the back end, with working knowledge of relational databases, RESTful APIs and version control. Focused on readable code, predictable releases and features that solve a stated business problem rather than an imagined one.

bullets: Built and shipped internal web applications using Laravel and MySQL, taking features from written requirement through to release.
Developed responsive interfaces with React.js and Tailwind CSS, keeping behaviour consistent across browsers and screen sizes.
Designed and documented RESTful APIs consumed by both the web client and a third-party reporting tool.
Reduced page load times by profiling slow database queries and adding the indexes the query plans showed were missing.
Managed branches, reviews and releases in Git and GitHub as part of a four-developer team.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science

projects.title: Inventory Tracker (Full-Stack Application)
projects.description: Built a stock-tracking tool for a small retailer, covering purchase orders, stock levels and low-stock alerts. Modelled the schema in PostgreSQL and exposed the data through a RESTful API consumed by a React.js front end.
projects.tech: Frontend: React.js, Tailwind CSS, Backend: Node.js, Express.js, RESTful APIs, Database: PostgreSQL.

projects.title: Recipe Search API
projects.description: Developed a small search service over a recipe dataset, with filtering by ingredient and dietary tag. Wrote the query layer against MySQL and documented every endpoint before building the client.
projects.tech: Backend: Laravel, PHP, RESTful APIs, Database: MySQL.
